name: com.three-unity.bridge
description: Imports .threeunity scene assets and launches packaged Three.js web builds inside Unity players.

samples.description: A minimal .threeunity asset that can be dragged into a scene.
A self-contained animated .threeunity character with a skinned mesh, bone hierarchy, and looping clip.
Binds a Door descriptor to a sample MonoBehaviour that opens automatically from descriptor data.
Imports two morph targets as Unity BlendShapes and plays a looping morph-weight animation.
Plays looping base color, emission, opacity, roughness, and base-map UV animation through MaterialPropertyBlock bindings.
Imports continuous and segmented lines, a closed loop, a grouped vertex-colored point cloud, and camera-facing sprites with looping transform and material animation.
